_comment: Public marketplace listing manifest. Subject to Anthropic spec finalization (claude-plugins-official). Fields modelled on common plugin marketplace conventions (VS Code, Cursor, Anthropic Skills). Update when the official Claude Code plugin marketplace schema lands.
name: artibot
displayName: Artibot — Autonomous Agent OS for Claude Code
description: Cognitive orchestration framework with dual-process routing, lifelong learning, expert agent teams, and workflow automation for Claude Code. 28 agents, 113 skills, 75 commands, 9,900+ tests.
shortDescription: Autonomous Agent OS — 28 agents, 113 skills, dual-process cognition, lifelong learning, parallel teams.
tagline: Production-grade autonomous agent OS that orchestrates the work for you.

platformNotes.claude-code: Native — full feature set including Agent Teams API, hooks, MCP server, statusline.
platformNotes.cursor: Subset — agents/skills via AGENTS.md alias and `scripts/export-to-tool.mjs --tool=cursor`.
platformNotes.codex-cli: Subset — agents exported (Team Collaboration sections stripped) via `scripts/export-to-tool.mjs --tool=codex`.
platformNotes.opencode: Subset — agents exported (Team Collaboration sections stripped) via `scripts/export-to-tool.mjs --tool=opencode`.

features.name: Parallel Agent Teams
features.description: Native Claude Agent Teams API integration (TeamCreate / SendMessage / TaskCreate) with automatic decomposition and cross-verification.

features.name: Dual-Process Cognitive Routing
features.description: System 1 / System 2 routing with EFFORT_POLICY: fast inline path for trivial work, deliberate parallel path for complex multi-domain tasks.

features.name: Lifelong Learning Loop
features.description: GRPO + skill-evolver + drift-detector + skill-lifecycle-autopilot — production-grade self-improvement across sessions.

features.name: Built-in Observability
features.description: 11-stage middleware emits hook events; OTEL exporter (opt-in, loopback-preferred); multi-session dashboard with token / cost aggregates.

features.name: Data Sovereignty
features.description: Strict no-external-DB policy. All data stays in local Artibot plugin and the user's own server. No third-party telemetry.

features.name: Cross-tool Export
features.description: AGENTS.md alias + export adapters (Cursor, Codex CLI, OpenCode) — write once, run on multiple AI dev tools.
